To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
PDA technology can be used in a variety of ways to support teaching and learning.
PDA technology can be an effective tool in teaching and learning if teachers have the opportunity to explore the educational affordances and the preconceptions underlying those affordances.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the educational affordances and preconceptions of an experienced technology using teacher with an educational technology background, who is exploring PDA technology.
the educational affordances perceived by a teacher who is exploring the use of PDAP technology in a technology education context, with a view to developing his own teaching practice.
understanding how teachers think about educational affordances and how their thinking changes when they are exposed to new technologies.

the educational affordances that PDAs offer to teachers are: (a) a tool that can be used to enhance learning and teaching, (b) a tool that supports the development of higher-order thinking skills, (c) a tool that is a powerful personal learning tool, (d) a tool that enables teachers to support learning in different ways, and (e) a tool that enhances the learning experience.
